record.question: Who invented Television?
record.explanation: Science Museum identifies Baird as inventor of the first television and describes his later 1928 colour demonstration. Baird is the only listed television pioneer. Clarify mechanical television; electronic television had other contributors. The broad invention history alone does not make a distractor equally defensible. Historical exam context: 2018 (year only; no day/month printed). This is the source-era answer; time-sensitive roles, rankings and memberships may have changed. Evidence: https://blog.sciencemuseum.org.uk/how-the-1967-wimbledon-championships-made-broadcasting-history/ Independently checked solution, unofficial. No matching examiner answer key is asserted.
